intro: A crate of footwear dispatched from Booty Bay by the merchant Drizzlik, intended for Gazlowe's trade network in Ratchet. It was intercepted off the coast by Southsea Freebooters and stashed away in their encampment south of the port.

p: Running a goblin trade port requires endless supplies, and Gazlowe arranged for a fresh delivery of boots from Drizzlik, a purveyor of apparel based out of Booty Bay. The consignment never reached Ratchet's docks. Southsea Freebooters prowling the Merchant Coast ambushed the transport vessel, carrying the crates off to their beach encampments south of the harbor. The pirates scattered the stolen freight throughout their tents and shanties, leaving Gazlowe without his expected wares until adventurous mercenaries could be hired to scour the shoreline.
